groups.name: henge
groups.description: Henge: which @HengeService versions this process embeds, and how it reaches the others.

groups.name: henge.services
groups.description: Per service, by name: henge.services.<name>.mode (embedded | internal-rest) and .url, overridable per version as henge.services.<name>.versions.<n>.mode / .url. Unrecognized keys or service names fail startup.

groups.name: henge.store
groups.description: The datastore for Henge's shared state: henge.store.type picks it, henge.store.<type>.* configures it.

groups.name: henge.leases
groups.description: Per lease, by name: henge.leases.<lease>.capacity, the cluster-wide capacity services share out with @RequiresLease, and henge.leases.<lease>.amount, what one node claims of it.

groups.name: henge.rate-limits
groups.description: Per cluster-wide rate limiter, by name, injected with @RateLimited("<name>"): henge.rate-limits.<name>.permits drain every henge.rate-limits.<name>.period (both required; the period at most 1h), from a bucket of henge.rate-limits.<name>.capacity (the burst; defaults to permits).

groups.name: henge.server
groups.description: The /_henge dispatch endpoint this process serves.

groups.name: henge.topology
groups.description: The topology endpoint and page this process can serve.

groups.name: henge.channels
groups.description: Channels: long-lived connections to a client, multiplexed over one trunk per backend node.

groups.name: henge.transport
groups.description: The internal-rest client and its shared secret.

properties.name: henge.serve
properties.description: name[@version] entries naming what this process hosts; every other discovered service defaults to internal-rest. Names that match no @HengeService fail startup.

properties.name: henge.recent-versions
properties.description: How many of the most recent versions of each service this process runs; older implementations on the classpath are not run. A version named by defaultVersion(), henge.serve or henge.services outside the window fails startup.

properties.name: henge.remote-url-template
properties.description: URL for any internal-rest service without an explicit url, with {service} and {version} substituted, e.g. http://{service}.default.svc.cluster.local:8080. Other placeholders fail startup.

properties.name: henge.store.type
properties.description: Which datastore holds this process's shared state (leases, service advertisements): in-process, or the type of an adapter module on the classpath, e.g. redis. Setting it while also defining a SystemEphemeralDatastore bean fails startup.

properties.name: henge.store.backoff.initial
properties.description: After a call to the datastore fails, the wait before the first retry; every use of the datastore fails at once (StoreUnavailableException, a 503) until it has passed, then the wait doubles with each further failure. A bare number is milliseconds; 0 turns the backoff off.

properties.name: henge.store.backoff.max
properties.description: The longest the datastore is left alone after failing. What was last read about who hosts a service keeps being served meanwhile.

properties.name: henge.store.redis.uri
properties.description: For henge.store.type=redis: a Lettuce URI such as redis://host:6379/0 (rediss:// for TLS, redis://:password@host for a password). Required.

properties.name: henge.transport.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Calls made at most per invocation, the first included; 1 turns retries off. Only a call that provably never ran (a failed connection, or a process that doesn't serve the service) is retried.

properties.name: henge.transport.retry.backoff
properties.description: Wait before each retry. A bare number is milliseconds; 0 retries at once.

properties.name: henge.transport.retry.on
properties.description: Which failures are retried: connect (the connection couldn't be made), not-served (the process doesn't serve that service version), or both.

properties.name: henge.advertise.url
properties.description: Base URL other processes reach this one's /_henge at, published in its service advertisements, e.g. http://10.0.0.7:8080. Must be absolute http(s). Unset: advertisements give no address.

properties.name: henge.topology.enabled
properties.description: Whether this process serves its topology (services, modes, routes, the dependency graph, advertisements and leases) as JSON at <henge.server.path-prefix>/topology and as a page at /topology/ui. Off by default: it lists every service's host. With henge.transport.secret set, the JSON requires it; the page asks for it.

properties.name: henge.server.enabled
properties.description: Whether this process serves /_henge at all (a non-web application never does).

properties.name: henge.server.path-prefix
properties.description: Path prefix of the dispatch endpoint, for both the server and the client side. Must start with '/' and not end with one.

properties.name: henge.transport.secret
properties.description: Optional shared secret, sent as the Henge-Internal-Secret header and required by the dispatcher; with Spring Security it becomes an authentication. Unset is supported: the network is the boundary.

properties.name: henge.transport.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connect timeout of internal-rest calls. A bare number is milliseconds; 0 means no timeout.

properties.name: henge.transport.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout of internal-rest calls. A bare number is milliseconds; 0 means no timeout.

properties.name: henge.channels.queue-size
properties.description: Frames a channel may have queued, in each direction, before the channel is closed with 1013.

properties.name: henge.channels.max-frame-bytes
properties.description: The largest text or binary frame a channel carries. A larger one closes the channel with 1009.

properties.name: henge.channels.trunk.ping-interval
properties.description: How often a trunk to a backend is pinged; two missed pongs drop it and close its channels.

properties.name: henge.channels.trunk.idle-timeout
properties.description: How long a trunk with no channels is kept before it is closed.
